jobs.description: Nurse for the European Space Agency Noordwijk | HBO level Duties The European Space Research and Technology Centre (ESTEC) is the European Space Agency's main technology development and test centre for spacecraft and space technology. Over 2,400 people from more than 30 countries work at ESTEC in various capacities, with the majority being space engineers or scientists. In your role of nurse, you will join the ESTEC Medical Centre team who are looking after the overall health and wellbeing of the people working at ESTEC. The job will also include administrative tasks, such as handling appointments and correspondence, updating medical files and carrying out contact tracing in cases of Covid-19 infections. Medical assistance is provided as required, usually related to the treatment of minor ailments or the arrangement of consultations with dedicated specialists. Education You should have a relevant nursing qualification at HBO level. A first professional experience in a medical service is required. Prior experience in occupational health will be an asset. Knowledge of Microsoft Office, in particular Word, Outlook and Excel, is required. As English is the main working language at ESTEC, you will need to be fluent in English, both spoken and written. As you will also need to interact with local medical professionals and hospitals, it would be helpful if you can speak Dutch. Knowledge of other languages will be an asset. What we offer A stimulating and inspiring working environment is just one of the benefits of working at ESA.
